architecture.mechanism: Molybdenum and chromium additions modify the microstructure of white cast iron, improving its resistance to abrasive wear and corrosion.
architecture.intervention: Optimize the chromium-molybdenum ratio in the white iron impeller composition to maximize resistance to both hydro-abrasive erosion and acidic corrosion.
architecture.expected_effect: Extended impeller service life beyond 1100 running hours by improving material resistance to the combined attack of 40% solids at pH 2.5.
architecture.falsification_test: Comparative testing of impellers with varying chromium-molybdenum ratios in identical operating conditions to measure wear rates and corrosion resistance.
